newsitem.title: Spain: Spain's Barcelona issues 10-yr 20 bln pta bond. [corrected 13:30 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Spain's Barcelona issues 10-yr 20 bln pta bond. [corrected 13:30 gmt]

text.p: Catalonia's city of Barcelona is issuing a municipal bond of 20 billion pesetas with 10-year maturity, lead managers said on Tuesday.
The bonds have a yearly coupon of seven percent, effective on December 18.
Pay date is May 6, and maturity on May 6 2007.
BBV, Bank of America, Banco de Negocios Argentaria, La Caixa and Societe Generale are joint lead managers. (Corrects lead managers).
